indications.indication: Recurrent, fully resected pulmonary metastatic osteosarcoma
indications.trial_design: Open-label, single-arm Phase 2b study of OST-HER2 maintenance after resection of recurrent osteosarcoma (N=41 enrolled); primary endpoint 12-month EFS met (33.3% vs 20% historical control, p=0.0158); 2-year OS 75% vs 40% historical control
indications.trial_status: Primary endpoint met; rolling BLA submission to FDA initiated; FDA action target by 2026-09-30 under Accelerated Approval Program
key_milestones: BLA clinical module submission target Mar 2026

excluded_preclinical.reason: Tunable antibody-drug conjugate platform; preclinical; intended for osteosarcoma and other solid tumors
